name: std::locale::operator=
intro: Creates a copy of other, replacing the contents of *this. The reference counts of all facets held by other are incremented. The reference counts of all facets previously held by *this are decremented, and those facets whose reference count becomes zero are deleted.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Returns *this, which is now a copy of other.
